pages.text: A recovered bloom folds while it is carried. Behind glass, the shutters can be coaxed into their old movement.
pages.title: Things brought back
Choose the experiment
pages.text: One specimen can become a Bloom Engine, a Field Ward or a Heartglass Lens. Each recipe consumes the specimen. Decide what the next journey lacks before committing it.

pages.title: A contained source
pages.text: The Bloom Engine holds its specimen inside a closed chamber. Supply essence to keep it working. One essence supports thirty running seconds at up to 80 Resonance per tick. A full bank pauses consumption; an unfed chamber goes

pages.title: A contained source
pages.text: This is a workshop source. Opening the surrounding field is a separate experiment.

pages.title: Carry a reserve
pages.text: A Resonance Cell holds 16000 Resonance and starts empty. Sneak-use a generator to charge it; use a receiver normally to supply it. Compatible FE chargers also work.

pages.title: Carry a reserve
pages.text: Carry a charged cell rather than assuming there will be a working workshop at the far end.

pages.title: A quiet camp
pages.text: Place a Field Ward and use a cell holding at least 4000 Resonance. It holds attention steady within eight blocks for two minutes. Check the remaining time with an empty hand.

pages.title: A quiet camp
pages.text: It does not lower attention already gathered, stop an existing hunt, or block infection. Breaking the ward loses its remaining charge. Its two minutes pass even if you leave it behind.

pages.title: Measure a bearing
pages.text: Carry a Heartglass Lens and a charged cell, then finish a reading with the expedition compass. A measurement costs 200 Resonance and gives horizontal distance and signed height.

pages.title: Measure a bearing
pages.text: Without that charge, the ordinary needle and elevation ember still work. The lens belongs to you after extraction.

pages.title: Opening the field
pages.text: For a controlled experiment, sneak-use an attunement sigil on a condenser holding at least 4000 Resonance. The open field reaches twenty-four blocks and consumes 20 Resonance per tick; refining pauses.

pages.title: Opening the field
